source_html: 4.1.2 第一类换元法（凑微分）(23题).html

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int x \sqrt { a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } } d x \text{ 的值为[ ]}

options.label: A
options.html: - \frac { 1 } { 3 } ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) ^ { \frac { 3 } { 2 } } + C \, .

options.label: B
options.html: (a^{2}-x^{2})^{\frac{3}{2}}+C\,;

options.label: C
options.html: - \frac { 1 } { 2 } ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) ^ { \frac { 3 } { 2 } } + C

options.label: D
options.html: - \frac { 1 } { 2 } ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 2 } } + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) ^ { \frac { 1 } { 2 } } \cdot ( - \frac { 1 } { 2 } ) d ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) = - \frac { 1 } { 3 } ( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } ) ^ { \frac { 3 } { 2 } } + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \sin ^ { 2 } x \cos x d x \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{3} \sin^{3} x + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{2}\sin^{2}x+C

options.label: C
options.html: \sin ^ { 3 } x + C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{3} \sin^{2} x + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 注意到}d(\sin x)=\cos x d x, \text{令}u=\sin x,\,du=\cos dx, \text{于是}\\&\int \sin^{2}x \cos x d x=\int \sin^{2}x d(\sin x)=\int u^{2}du=\frac{1}{3}u^{3}+C=\frac{1}{3}\sin^{3}x+C.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int x e ^ { x ^ { 2 } } d x \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{array}{c}e^{x^{2}}+C\end{array}

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{2} e^{x^{2}} + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{2}e^{x^{2}}+C

options.label: D
options.html: e^{x} + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int e^{x^{2}} x dx = \frac{1}{2} \int e^{x^{2}} dx^{2} = \frac{1}{2} e^{x^{2}} + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int e^{3x} dx \text{ 的值为[ }

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{3}e^{3x} + C

options.label: B
options.html: e^{\frac{1}{3}x} + C

options.label: C
options.html: e^{3x} + C

options.label: D
options.html: 3 e^{x} + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int e^{3x} \cdot \frac{1}{3} \cdot 3dx = \frac{1}{3} \int e^{3x} (3x)^{\prime}dx = \frac{1}{3} \int e^{3x} d(3x) = \frac{1}{3} e^{3x} + C.

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \cos ^{2} x dx \text{ 的值为 } [ \quad ].

options.label: A
options.html: x + \sin 2 x + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{2}x + \sin\,2x + C

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}x + \frac{1}{4} \sin 2x + C\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{2}x + \frac{1}{4}\sin 2x + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答 原式} \\ = \int \frac {1 + \cos 2 x}{2} d x = \int \frac {1}{2} d x + \frac {1}{2} \int \cos 2 x d x = \frac {1}{2} x + \frac {1}{2} \cdot \frac {1}{2} \int \cos 2 x d 2 x = \frac {1}{2} x + \frac {1}{4} \sin 2 x + C \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \sin ^ { 2 } x \cdot \cos ^ { 5 } x d x \text{ 的值为 } [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \sin ^ { 3 } x - \frac { 2 } { 5 } \sin ^ { 5 } x + \frac { 1 } { 7 } \sin ^ { 7 } x + C = 0

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \sin ^ { 3 } x + \frac { 2 } { 5 } \sin ^ { 5 } x + \frac { 1 } { 7 } \sin ^ { 7 } x + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \sin ^ { 3 } x + \frac { 2 } { 5 } \sin ^ { 5 } x - \frac { 1 } { 7 } \sin ^ { 7 } x + C \text { ; }

options.label: D
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \sin ^ { 3 } x - \frac { 2 } { 5 } \sin ^ { 5 } x - \frac { 1 } { 7 } \sin ^ { 7 } x + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答} \ \ & \text{原式} = \int \sin^2 x - \cos^4 x d(\sin x) = \int \sin^2 x (1 - \sin^2 x)^2 d(\sin x) = \int (\sin^2 x - 2 \sin^4 x + \sin^6 x) d(\sin x) \\&= \frac{1}{3} \sin^3 x - \frac{2}{5} \sin^5 x + \frac{1}{7} \sin^7 x + C \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \ \int ( \tan x - \sec x ) ^ { 2 } d x \text{ 的值为 } \ [ \quad ] .

options.label: A
options.html: \left. \right) 2 \tan x + x - \frac{2}{\sin x} + C

options.label: B
options.html: \,2 \tan x + x - { \frac { 2 } { \cos x } } + C

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}2 \tan x - x - \frac{2}{\cos x} + C\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}2 \tan x - x - \frac{2}{\sin x} + C\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} I = \int (\tan^{2} x + \sec^{2} x - 2 \tan x \sec x) dx = \int (2 \sec^{2} x - 1 - 2 \frac{\sin x}{\cos^{2} x}) dx \\ = 2 \int \sec^{2} x dx - \int 1 dx - \int (\frac{2}{\cos x})^{\prime} dx = 2 \tan x - x - \frac{2}{\cos x} + C \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int (3x-1) \sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7} dx \text{ 的值为 } \quad[ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{ (3 x ^ { 2 } - 2 x + 7 ) ^ { 3 } } + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \sqrt { ( 3 x ^ { 2 } - 2 x + 7 ) ^ { 3 } } + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{3}(3x^{2}-2x+7)^{2/3}+C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{6}(3x^{2}-2x+7)^{3/2}+C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&(3x-1)\sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7}=\frac{1}{2}(6x-2)\sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7},\ \text{则有}\\&\int(3x-1)\sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7}dx=\frac{1}{2}\int(6x-2)\sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7}dx\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int\sqrt{3x^{2}-2x+7}d(3x^{2}-2x+7)=\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{2}{3}(3x^{2}-2x+7)^{\frac{3}{2}}+C=\frac{1}{3}\sqrt{(3x^{2}-2x+7)^{3}}+C\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \ \int \frac{a^{x}-a^{-x}}{a^{x}+a^{-x}}dx \text{ 的值为 } \ [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \ln ( a ^ { x } + a ^ { - x } ) + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { \ln ( a ^ { x } - a ^ { - x } ) } { \ln a } + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{ \ln (a^{x} + a^{-x})}{\ln a} + C

options.label: D
options.html: \ln ( a ^ { x } - a ^ { - x } ) + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解析 注意到} (a^{x}+a^{-x})'=(a^{x}-a^{-x})\ln a,\text {因此应用凑微分法可得} \\ I=\frac{1}{\ln a}\int \frac{(a^{x}+a^{-x})'}{a^{x}+a^{-x}}dx=\frac{\ln(a^{x}+a^{-x})}{\ln a}+C \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int ( 2 x + 3 ) ^ { 5 } d x \text{的值为} [ \quad ].

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{6}(2x+3)^{5}+C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{12} \bigl( 2x + 3 \bigr)^{6} + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{12}(2x+3)^{6}+C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{6}(2x+3)^{6}+C\,;

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答：原式} = \frac{1}{2} \int (2x+3)^{5} \cdot (2x+3)^{\prime} dx = \frac{1}{2} \int (2x+3)^{5} d(2x+3) = \frac{1}{2} \int u^{5} du = \frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{6} u^{6} + C = \frac{1}{12} (2x+3)^{6} + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{ \ln x+1}{1+x \ln x} dx \text{ 的值为 } \quad [ \quad ].

options.label: A
options.html: \ln \left| 1 + \ln x \right| + C

options.label: B
options.html: \ln \left| 1 + x \ln x \right| + C

options.label: C
options.html: \ln | 1 - \ln x | + C

options.label: D
options.html: \ln \left| 1 - x \ln x \right| + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解析 注意到} (x \ln x)^{\prime} = \ln x + 1, \text {因此应用凑微分法,有} \\ I = \int \frac {(x \ln x)^{\prime}}{1 + x \ln x} dx = \ln | 1 + x \ln x | + C \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \cdot \text{不定积分} \int \frac{dx}{x^{2}-a^{2}} \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \ln \left| \frac{x-a}{x+a} \right| + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac {1}{a} \ln \left| \frac {x - a}{x + a} \right| + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac {1}{a} \ln \left| \frac {x + a}{x - a} \right| + C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{2a} \ln \left| \frac{x-a}{x+a} \right| + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} { \text {解答 原式}} \\ \\ \quad = \int { \frac { 1 } { ( x - a ) ( x + a ) } } d x = { \frac { 1 } { 2 a } } \int ( { \frac { 1 } { x - a } } - { \frac { 1 } { x + a } } ) d x = { \frac { 1 } { 2 a } } ( \int { \frac { 1 } { x - a } } d x - \int { \frac { 1 } { x + a } } d x ) = { \frac { 1 } { 2 a } } \ln { \left| { \frac { x - a } { x + a } } \right| } + C \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac { \ln ^ { 2 } x } { x } d x \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } \ln ^ { 3 } x + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{6}\ln^{3}x+C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 3 } { \ln } ^ { 2 } x + C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{6}\ln^{2}x+C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int \ln ^{2} x \, d \ln x = \frac { 1 } { 3 } \ln ^ { 3 } x + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{\sin 2x}{a^{2}\sin^{2}x+b^{2}\cos x}dx(a^{2}\neq b^{2})\text{的值为} \quad [\quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac { 1 } { a ^ { 2 } + b ^ { 2 } } \ln ( a ^ { 2 } \sin ^ { 2 } x + b ^ { 2 } \cos ^ { 2 } x ) + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{a^{2}-b^{2}}\ln(a^{2}\sin^{2}2x+b^{2}\cos^{2}2x)+C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { a ^ { 2 } - b ^ { 2 } } \ln ( a ^ { 2 } \sin ^ { 2 } x + b ^ { 2 } \cos ^ { 2 } x ) + C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac { 1 } { a ^ { 2 } + b ^ { 2 } } \ln ( a ^ { 2 } \sin ^ { 2 } 2 x + b ^ { 2 } \cos ^ { 2 } 2 x ) + C = 0

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 注意到} (a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x)' = (a^2 - b^2) \sin 2x\,, \text{因此可得，} \\ I = \frac{1}{a^2 - b^2} \int \frac{(a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x)'}{a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x} = \frac{1}{a^2 - b^2} \ln(a^2 \sin^2 x + b^2 \cos^2 x) + C \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \tan x dx \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \ln | \sin x | + C

options.label: B
options.html: \ln | \cot x | + C

options.label: C
options.html: \ln | \sec x | + C

options.label: D
options.html: \ln | \cos x | + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int \frac { 1 } { \cos x } \cdot \sin x \, dx = - \int \frac { 1 } { \cos x } \, d \cos x = - \ln | \cos x | + C = \ln | \sec x | + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac {1}{a^{2}+x^{2}}\,dx \text{的值为} \left[ \ \ \ \right]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac { 1 } { a } a r c \cot \frac { x } { a } + C =

options.label: B
options.html: \arctan { \frac { x } { a } } + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 } { a } \arctan \frac { x } { a } + C \text{ :}

options.label: D
options.html: \operatorname{arccot} {\frac {x}{a}} + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \frac { 1 } { a ^ { 2 } } \int \frac { 1 } { 1 + \frac { x ^ { 2 } } { a ^ { 2 } } } d x = \frac { 1 } { a } \int \frac { 1 } { 1 + \left( \frac { x } { a } \right) ^ { 2 } } d ( \frac { x } { a } ) = \frac { 1 } { a } \arctan \frac { x } { a } + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{1}{3x^{2}+3x-1} dx \text{ 的值为 } \quad[ \quad].

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{\sqrt{21}} \ln \left| \frac{\sqrt{3}(2x+1)-\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{3}(x+1)+\sqrt{7}} \right| + C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac {1}{\sqrt {21}} \ln \left| \frac {\sqrt {3} (2 x + 1) - \sqrt {7}}{(2 x + 1) + \sqrt {7}} \right| + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{\sqrt{21}} \ln \left| \frac{\sqrt{3}(2x+1)-\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{3}(2x+1)+\sqrt{7}} \right| + C,

options.label: D
options.html: \frac {1}{\sqrt {21}} \ln \left| \frac {\sqrt {3} (x + 1) - \sqrt {7}}{(2 x + 1) - \sqrt {7}} \right| + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} { r } { I = \frac { 1 } { 3 } \int \frac { d x } { ( x + \frac { 1 } { 2 } ) ^ { 2 } - 7 / 12 } = \frac { 1 } { 3 } \frac { 1 } { 2 \sqrt { 7 / 12 } } \ln \left| \frac { x + 1 / 2 - \sqrt { 7 / 12 } } { x + 1 / 2 + \sqrt { 7 / 12 } } \right| + C = - \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 21 } } \ln \left| \frac { \sqrt { 3 } ( 2 x + 1 ) - \sqrt { 7 } } { \sqrt { 3 } ( 2 x + 1 ) + \sqrt { 7 } } \right| + C } \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac {1}{1 + e ^ {x}} d x \text { 的值 } [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: x + \ln ( 1 + e ^ { x } ) + C

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}2x-\ln(1+e^x)+C\end{aligned}

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}2x + \ln (1 + e^x) + C \, ;\end{aligned}

options.label: D
options.html: x - \ln (1 + e^{x}) + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int \frac { 1 + e ^ { x } - e ^ { x } } { 1 + e ^ { x } } \, dx = \int ( 1 - \frac { e ^ { x } } { 1 + e ^ { x } } ) d x = \int d x - \int \frac { 1 } { 1 + e ^ { x } } \, d ( 1 + e ^ { x } ) = x - \ln ( 1 + e ^ { x } ) + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{1}{\sqrt{3x^{2}+3x-1}} dx \text{的值为} \quad [ \quad ].

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\ln\left|{\frac{\sqrt{3}(2x+1)+\sqrt{x^{2}+3x-1}}{2\sqrt{3}}}\right|+C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 3 } } \ln \left| \frac { \sqrt { 3 } ( 2 x + 1 ) - \sqrt { 3 x ^ { 2 } + 3 x - 1 } } { \sqrt { 3 } } \right| + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \ln \left| \sqrt{3} (2x+1) + \sqrt{3x^{2}+3x-1} \right| + C \, ;

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \ln \left| - \sqrt{3} (x+1) + \sqrt{3 x^{2}+3 x-1} \right| + C,

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}I&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{(x+\frac{1}{2})^{2}-7/12}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\ln \left|x+\frac{1}{2}+\sqrt{(x+\frac{1}{2})^{2}-7/12}\right|+C=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\ln \left|\frac{\sqrt{5}(2x+1)+\sqrt{3x^{2}+3x-1}}{2\sqrt{3}}\right|+C\\&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\ln \left|\sqrt{5}(2x+1)+\sqrt{3x^{2}+3x-1}\right|+C\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac { \arctan \sqrt { x } d x } { \sqrt { x } ( 1 + x ) } \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \left( \arccos \sqrt { x } \right) ^ { 2 } + C

options.label: B
options.html: (arx\tan{\sqrt{x}})^{2}+C

options.label: C
options.html: (\operatorname{arccsc}{\sqrt{x}})^{2} + C\,.

options.label: D
options.html: (\arcsin \sqrt { x } ) ^ { 2 } + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int \frac { \arctan \sqrt { x } } { 1 + ( \sqrt { x } ) ^ { 2 } } \, 2 d \sqrt { x } = 2 \int \arctan \sqrt { x } d \arctan \sqrt { x } = ( \arctan \sqrt { x } ) ^ { 2 } + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{1}{x(1+2\ln x)} dx \text{的值为} [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{2}\ln(1+2x)+C

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { 1 } { 2 } \ln ( 1 + 2 \ln x ) + C \ ;

options.label: C
options.html: \ln ( 1 + 2 \ln x ) + C

options.label: D
options.html: \ln ( 1 + \ln x ) + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \int \frac{1}{x(1+2\ln x)} dx = \int \frac{1}{1+2\ln x} d(\ln x) = \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1}{1+2\ln x} d(1+2\ln x) = \frac{1}{2} \ln (1+2\ln x) + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac{1}{3+2x} dx \text{ 的值为 } [ \quad ]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{2}\ln(3+x)+C

options.label: B
options.html: \ln (3 + 2 x) + C

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{2} \ln (3 + 2 x) + C

options.label: D
options.html: \ln ( 3 + x ) + C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \int \frac { 1 } { 3 + 2 x } d ( 3 + 2 x ) = \frac { 1 } { 2 } \ln ( 3 + 2 x ) + C

questions.prompt_html: \text{不定积分} \int \frac {x}{\left( 1 + x \right) ^ {3}} dx \text{的值为} \left[ \quad \right]

options.label: A
options.html: \frac{1}{1+x}+\frac{1}{2(1+x)^{2}}+C

options.label: B
options.html: - \frac { 1 } { 1 + x } + \frac { 1 } { 2 ( 1 + x ) ^ { 2 } } + C

options.label: C
options.html: - \frac { 1 } { 1 + x } + \frac { 1 } { ( 1 + x ) ^ { 2 } } + C

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{1+x}+\frac{1}{\left(1+x\right)^{2}}+C

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ \ \text{原式} = \int \frac { x + 1 - 1 } { ( 1 + x ) ^ { 3 } } \, dx = \int \left[ \frac { 1 } { ( 1 + x ) ^ { 2 } } - \frac { 1 } { ( 1 + x ) ^ { 3 } } \right] d ( 1 + x ) = - \frac { 1 } { 1 + x } + \frac { 1 } { 2 ( 1 + x ) ^ { 2 } } + C
